name: Ghost Rider

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Hinder: Yeni oluşturulan tüm buff'ların gücünü belirli bir yüzde azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Genesis: Bu şampiyon, rakibin aldığı hasarın belirtilen kısmını pasif olarak kendine can olarak kazanır.
abilityDetails.Fear: Unblockable yetenek doğruluğunu sabit %100 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok Şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Damnation: Süresi boyunca doğrudan hasar verir; aktifken rakip ayrıca İyileşme Engeli, Güç Kilidi ve Fate Seal altındadır.

signatureAbility:
Brother Blaze
Ghost Rider's Fury Passives gain [10 - 50]% potency.
Against #Villains, Ghost Rider's Genesis Passives gain [50 - 200]% potency.

abilitySections.title: Spirit of Vengeance - Always Active
content: The Rider's curse grants Immunity to Bleed and Incinerate.

abilitySections.title: Judgments
content: Certain actions cast indefinite Judgments onto the Opponent. Each individual Judgment cannot be re-cast while they are already active.
Casting a Judgment also activates an associated non-stacking effect. The duration of this effect is increased by 45% for each personal Judgment on the Opponent.
Casting a Judgment grants a +[829.12] Fury Passive until Penance Stare ends or Ghost Rider finishes his Special Attack 3. Max stacks: 5.
With more than 2 Bars of Power, the first hit of Ghost Rider's Heavy Attack consumes 50% of a Bar to also grant a personal Fury.

abilitySections.title: At the Start of the Fight Against a #Villain
content: Judgment of Guilt: Inflict a Stagger Passive for 2 seconds. This Judgment counts towards Ghost Rider's other abilities, but is not removed by them.

abilitySections.title: Finish a 5-Hit Combo with a Medium Attack
content: Judgment of Corruption: Inflict a 75% Hinder Passive for 8 seconds, paused during Ghost Rider's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Finish a 5-Hit Combo with a Light Attack
content: Judgment of Wrath: Inflict a 50% Atrophy Passive for 6 seconds, paused during Ghost Rider's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Charge a Heavy Attack
content: Judgment of Spite: Inflict a Power Steal Passive, stealing 25% of a Bar of Power over 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: After Using a Striker
content: Judgment of Retribution: Inflict a Degeneration Passive dealing [3,109.2] Direct Damage over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Hellfire Storm
content: On activation, cast the Judgment of Malice: Inflict a Fear Passive for 6 seconds.
On the final hit, inflict a non-stacking Incinerate Passive that deals [12,436.8] Energy Damage over 15 seconds, paused during Ghost Rider's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Look Into My Eyes
content: On activation, cast the Judgment of Greed: Gain a 2% Genesis Passive for 8 seconds.
After the final hit of this attack, Ghost Rider uses his Penance Stare for up to 3 seconds, or until he is interrupted or takes any action.

abilitySections.title: Penance Stare - After Special Attack 2
content: Penance Stare converts all Judgments and personal Incinerates into Degeneration Charges that expire one at a time over 3 seconds and are all removed when it ends.

If the Opponent is far from Ghost Rider when these Charges expire naturally, inflict a Degeneration Passive that deals [3,109.2] Direct Damage over 3 seconds. As an Attacker, inflict 3 additional Degenerations.

As an Attacker after the last hit of Special Attack 2, the first Degeneration inflicted also Passively Roots the Opponent until 0.5 seconds after Penance Stare ends. This Root will not re-trigger while already active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Evil's Bane
content: Inflict a Damnation Passive that deals [10,364] Direct Damage over 12 seconds, and then convert all Judgments into additional Damnations. 1 Damnation is removed when Ghost Rider is struck.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Brother Blaze
content: Ghost Rider's Fury Passives gain [10 - 50]% potency.
Against #Villains, Ghost Rider's Genesis Passives gain [50 - 200]% potency.
